description: Solar Pro 3 generated ExitGuide demo workflows based on Korean Consumer Agency standard consultation cases.

demo_input.user_goal: Cancel an OTT subscription now and avoid an unfair no-refund stop screen.
demo_input.screen_context: Subscription cancellation screen says the current billing cycle cannot be refunded.
visible_screen_text: No refund is available within the current billing cycle.
Cancellation applies from the next billing date.

model_result.screen_summary: The cancellation screen states that no refund is available within the current billing cycle and that cancellation applies from the next billing date.

goal_conflicts.screen_text: No refund is available within the current billing cycle.
goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: This conflicts with the user's goal to cancel now and avoid an unfair no-refund stop screen. The screen suggests refunds are impossible during the current cycle, which may be misleading under consumer protection laws.

goal_conflicts.screen_text: Cancellation applies from the next billing date.
goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: This could block immediate cancellation, which the user wants to achieve now. The reference case indicates that refunds may be possible within 7 days after the billing date.

reference_guidance.matched_point: OTT subscription is considered a 'continuous transaction' under Korean consumer protection law, allowing cancellation at any time during the contract period, and refund may be required if the consumer did not use the service.
reference_guidance.safe_user_facing_summary: You may be able to cancel now and request a refund, especially if you haven't used the service. The screen's statement about no refunds may not be legally binding.

recommended_action.primary: Proceed with cancellation and request refund details, noting that refunds may be possible within 7 days of the billing date if no service was used.
recommended_action.avoid: Stopping only because the screen says refund unavailable.
next_evidence_to_collect: Confirmation of service usage during this billing cycle
Exact billing date and days elapsed

demo_workflow_steps.output: User taps 'Continue cancellation' on the screen.
App sends cancellation request to backend API.
API processes cancellation request and returns confirmation with refund policy details.
System retrieves relevant consumer reference case (873) for comparison.
Agent compares screen text with reference case and identifies potential refund rights, then advises user to proceed with cancellation and request refund details.

evidence_quotes.quote: No refund is available within the current billing cycle.
Cancellation applies from the next billing date.
‘계속거래’는 계약기간 중 언제든지 해지할 수 있고, 사업자가 약관을 사유로 중도해지를 거부하는 경우 무효로 볼 수 있어 환급을 요구할 수 있습니다.
계약이 적법하게 해지되었고 고객이 서비스를 이용하지 않은 경우 매 결제일 이후 7일 이내(구독기간 1개월 기준)에 해지하면 자동 납부한 금액 환급을 요구할 수 있습니다.

demo_input.user_goal: Cancel an annual online video subscription and avoid an excessive penalty.
demo_input.screen_context: Cancellation screen says 50 percent of the remaining commitment will be charged.
visible_screen_text: 50 percent of the remaining commitment will be charged as a penalty.

model_result.screen_summary: Annual plan cancellation screen states that 50% of remaining commitment will be charged as a penalty, benefits end immediately, and offers two options: keep plan or accept penalty and cancel.

goal_conflicts.screen_text: 50 percent of the remaining commitment will be charged as a penalty.
goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: The screen presents a 50% penalty which may be considered excessive under consumer protection standards, potentially conflicting with the user's goal to avoid excessive charges.

reference_guidance.matched_point: The reference case states that a 50% refund clause can be considered invalid as an excessively burdensome penalty clause, and consumers can cancel by paying only 10% of the remaining period's usage fee according to the Consumer Dispute Resolution Standards.
reference_guidance.safe_user_facing_summary: You may be able to cancel by paying only 10% of the remaining period's usage fee instead of the 50% penalty shown on screen.

recommended_action.primary: Request confirmation from the service provider about the actual cancellation terms, as the screen's 50% penalty may not be legally enforceable.
recommended_action.avoid: Accepting the 50% penalty without first confirming if a lower amount (e.g., 10%) is legally required.
next_evidence_to_collect: Terms of service regarding cancellation penalties

demo_workflow_steps.output: User sees the cancellation screen showing 50% penalty and decides to seek clarification before proceeding.
App displays the cancellation screen with the 50% penalty notice and the two action buttons.
API retrieves the cancellation policy from the backend service provider.
System retrieves the relevant consumer reference case (Case 863) from the knowledge base.
Agent analyzes the screen text against the reference case and determines that the 50% penalty may be excessive, recommending further confirmation.

evidence_quotes.quote: 50 percent of the remaining commitment will be charged as a penalty.
잔여 약정 의무액의 50%만 환불하는 조항은 고객에게 부당하게 과중한 손해배상 의무를 부담시키는 약관조항일 뿐만 아니라... 무효에 해당하므로... 잔여기간 이용요금의 10%을 지급한 후 계약을 해지할 수 있다고 판단됩니다.

demo_input.user_goal: Cancel an online lecture contract and request a refund for the unused period.
demo_input.screen_context: Online lecture service says cancellation is allowed only after three or fewer lessons.
visible_screen_text: Mid-term cancellation is allowed only when three or fewer lessons were taken.
You have taken four lessons and are not eligible for a refund.

model_result.screen_summary: The screen states that mid-term cancellation is only allowed when three or fewer lessons have been taken, and the user has taken four lessons, making them ineligible for a refund according to the displayed policy.

goal_conflicts.screen_text: Mid-term cancellation is allowed only when three or fewer lessons were taken.
goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: The screen blocks the user's goal of canceling after four lessons, claiming they are not eligible for a refund, which may conflict with consumer protection laws that allow cancellation within a cooling-off period or under certain conditions.

goal_conflicts.screen_text: You have taken four lessons and are not eligible for a refund.
goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: The screen explicitly states the user is ineligible for a refund, which may be misleading if consumer protection laws provide for partial refunds or other remedies.

reference_guidance.matched_point: The consumer reference case indicates that for a 12-month internet lecture contract, cancellation is allowed even after 4 lessons, with refund calculated as days used plus 10% of remaining period, or full refund within 7 days of contract.
reference_guidance.safe_user_facing_summary: You may still be eligible for a partial refund even after taking four lessons, depending on the contract terms and applicable consumer protection laws. Contact support to discuss your options.

recommended_action.primary: Contact support to request a refund for the unused period, citing the consumer reference case and relevant consumer protection laws.
recommended_action.avoid: Do not stop only because the screen says refund unavailable; seek further clarification or escalate the request.
next_evidence_to_collect: Any written confirmation of cancellation policy

demo_workflow_steps.output: User reads the cancellation screen and sees they are ineligible for refund after 4 lessons.
User taps 'Contact support' button to initiate refund request.
Support ticket is created with user's cancellation request and lesson count.
System retrieves relevant consumer protection guidelines and contract terms for reference.
Agent reviews the case and prepares a response citing the consumer reference case and applicable laws.

evidence_quotes.quote: Mid-term cancellation is allowed only when three or fewer lessons were taken.
You have taken four lessons and are not eligible for a refund.
4강까지 수강하였더라도 사업자에게 중도해지 및 환급을 요구할 수 있습니다.
해지일까지의 이용 일수에 해당하는 금액과 잔여기간 이용금액의 10%를 공제한 후 환급하도록 규정하고 있습니다.

demo_input.user_goal: Cancel a one-year mobile app subscription and request a refund for the unused period.
demo_input.screen_context: Mobile app subscription screen says only cancellations within 48 hours receive a full refund.
visible_screen_text: Full refund is available only within 48 hours after payment.
No refund is provided for the remaining period.

model_result.screen_summary: The mobile app subscription screen states that only cancellations within 48 hours after payment receive a full refund, and no refund is provided for the remaining period.

goal_conflicts.screen_text: Full refund is available only within 48 hours after payment.
goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: This screen text directly contradicts the user's goal of receiving a refund for the unused period after the 48-hour window, creating a potential barrier to achieving the desired outcome.

goal_conflicts.screen_text: No refund is provided for the remaining period.
goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: This statement suggests that refunds for unused periods are categorically unavailable, which conflicts with the user's expectation of prorated refund based on unused time.

reference_guidance.matched_point: The consumer reference case confirms that mid-term refund clauses are invalid under Korean consumer protection laws, and consumers can request refunds after deducting 10% of the remaining period fee.
reference_guidance.safe_user_facing_summary: You may request a refund for the unused period after deducting 10% of the remaining fee, regardless of the 48-hour window stated on the screen.

recommended_action.primary: Request cancellation and ask for a prorated refund (deducting 10% of remaining period fee) even though it's past 48 hours.
recommended_action.avoid: Accepting the screen's statement that no refund is available for the remaining period.
next_evidence_to_collect: Payment receipt showing subscription start date
Terms of service regarding refund policy

demo_workflow_steps.output: User taps 'Request cancellation' on the mobile app screen.
App shows cancellation confirmation screen with refund policy text.
User reads the refund policy and notes the 48-hour limitation.
API retrieves consumer reference case 435 regarding mobile app mid-term refund rights.
System extracts key legal guidance: 10% deduction allowed, 48-hour clause invalid.
Agent informs user that they may request a prorated refund despite the screen's statement.

evidence_quotes.quote: Full refund is available only within 48 hours after payment.
No refund is provided for the remaining period.
해지일까지의 이용일수에 해당하는 금액과 잔여기간 이용요금의 10% 공제 후 나머지 금액에 대해 환급을 요구할 수 있습니다.

demo_input.user_goal: Cancel a water purifier rental contract made through door-to-door sales shortly after installation.
demo_input.screen_context: Rental contract screen says cancellation is unavailable after installation.
visible_screen_text: Keeping the contract preserves promotional benefits.

model_result.screen_summary: The rental contract screen states that cancellation is unavailable after installation and encourages keeping the contract to preserve promotional benefits.

goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: The screen claims cancellation is impossible after installation, which contradicts the consumer's right to cancel within 14 days of door-to-door sales under Korean consumer protection laws.

goal_conflicts.screen_text: Keeping the contract preserves promotional benefits.
goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: This phrasing suggests promotional benefits are tied to keeping the contract, potentially misleading consumers about their cancellation rights.

reference_guidance.matched_point: Applicable law allows cancellation within 14 days of door-to-door sales regardless of installation status.
reference_guidance.safe_user_facing_summary: You may request cancellation within 14 days of signing the door-to-door rental contract. The screen's statement that cancellation is unavailable after installation may not reflect your legal rights.

recommended_action.primary: Ask about cancellation using a method that provides proof (e.g., email or written request).
recommended_action.avoid: Stopping only because the screen says refund unavailable.

demo_workflow_steps.output: User sees the screen stating cancellation is unavailable after installation and considers their goal to cancel shortly after installation.
App presents the screen text and offers an option to 'Ask about cancellation' which routes to customer service.
API retrieves the consumer reference case (970) about door-to-door water purifier rental cancellation rights.
System extracts key legal points: 14-day cooling-off period applies even after installation for door-to-door sales.
Agent informs user that while the screen says cancellation is unavailable, Korean law may allow cancellation within 14 days, and they should request cancellation with proof.

evidence_quotes.quote: Keeping the contract preserves promotional benefits.
방문판매원을 통해 계약을 체결하였다면 「방문판매 등에 관한 법률」 제8조(청약철회등)에 따라 정수기를 설치한 날로부터 14일 이내에 서면으로 계약의 해제 또는 청약의 철회를 요구할 수 있습니다.

demo_input.user_goal: Withdraw from a stock auto-trading information service sold by phone solicitation and request a refund.
demo_input.screen_context: Information service screen says refund is unavailable because the product includes intellectual property.
visible_screen_text: This digital content includes intellectual property and is non-refundable.

model_result.screen_summary: The screen states that withdrawal is possible but the service is non-refundable due to intellectual property, and that provided information cannot be recovered.

goal_conflicts.screen_text: This digital content includes intellectual property and is non-refundable.
goal_conflicts.why_it_matters: The screen explicitly claims refunds are unavailable, which conflicts with the user's goal of obtaining a refund.
This suggests the service cannot be returned, potentially blocking the user's ability to withdraw and get a refund.

reference_guidance.matched_point: The reference case confirms that for phone-solicited stock auto-trading information services, withdrawal is possible within 14 days, and refund refusal based solely on intellectual property is not valid unless proper measures were taken to prevent withdrawal.
reference_guidance.safe_user_facing_summary: You may request a refund within the withdrawal period, but the business might refuse if they took steps to prevent withdrawal (like showing non-refundable notices or providing trial content).

recommended_action.primary: Request withdrawal and ask for refund despite the screen's claim.
recommended_action.avoid: Stopping the process only because the screen says refund unavailable.
next_evidence_to_collect: Confirmation of whether the business displayed non-refundable notices or provided trial content
Proof of when you received the contract and when the service started

demo_workflow_steps.output: User sees the screen stating non-refundable due to intellectual property and decides to proceed with withdrawal request.
App presents the withdrawal request form and notes the refund limitation.
API sends withdrawal request to backend with user's intent to request refund.
System retrieves relevant consumer protection law and reference case information.
Agent informs user that while the screen says non-refundable, they may still request a refund within the withdrawal period, and advises to proceed with the request.

evidence_quotes.quote: This digital content includes intellectual property and is non-refundable.
청약철회 기간 이내이면 환급 요구가 가능하나 청약철회 등이 불가능하다는 사실의 표시와 함께 시험사용 상품을 제공하는 등의 방법으로 청약철회 등의 권리행사가 방해받지 않도록 조치를 했다면 청약철회가 제한될 수 있습니다.
